description: Hello frame on connect, stats request, client control ping and its reply, then close.
notes: hello: d.ts = server ms epoch, d.v = "5", d.h = the emulator host:port (see origin.json: it does not follow the Host header), d.s = random 32-char session id.
The control ping is answered with a control pong (t:"o"); stats get a normal ok reply.
close initiated by the client (close frame with code 1000) on: A; the code recorded is what the client saw in the emulator's closing reply (1005 = the reply carried no status code).
